channel.title: Violations Watch: new incidents
channel.description: New entries in the open log of reported violations of international humanitarian and human rights law. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Gunmen kill a Living Faith pastor and two relatives in Takum, Taraba State (Truth Nigeria)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Takum, Taraba, Nigeria. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified gunmen. Reported casualties: 3 killed. Disputed or caveats: Single faith-focused outlet; date not stated. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1360
